# Initial Setup

## Introductions in Random Channel

Please go to the **Random channel in Teams** and **introduce yourself** to the rest of the students in the course. For your introduction, include just a few sentences of information about yourself (personal and/or professional). (You could also share what you hope to get out of this course or a question you are hoping this course will answer.)

If you can do this by uploading a video, that would be great. If you are unable to create a video and are responding via text, give us a snapshot of yourself in a few sentences. Feel free to attach a picture to your post. This works best in the attachment box below the discussion forum text box.

Please check out the channel at the end of our first week and take some time to get to know your classmates. While not required, you should feel free to post replies to others' posts throughout the term. Enjoy the term and remember to contact your instructor if you have any questions.

**Continue to share fun posts, pics, videos, or other items that add to our course culture throughout the term.**
